sections.heading: Thank you for submitting your Fall 2016 Registration
sections.html:
Next Steps

  • On July 15, Sunflower will notify you by email if you have a spot in the class of your choice. Please add Classes@SunflowerCreativeArts to your email address book or safe sender list.
  • You must respond to that email in order to accept your spot in the class.

Paid Programs

After you respond to the email, Sunflower will send you an invoice via email. You must pay by July 22, 5:00pm, to confirm your spot and complete registration. Otherwise your spot may be offered to another family on the waitlist. Sunflower class sizes are small, and all classes are extremely popular.

Remember: your Fall Registration is only complete once you have provided payment.

Free Programs

You must respond to that email by July 22, 5:00pm, in order to accept your spot in the class. Otherwise your spot may be offered to another family on the waitlist. Sunflower class sizes are small, and all classes are extremely popular.

Remember: your Fall Registration is only complete once you’ve been notified and you accept your spot.

Thank you for choosing to be part of the Sunflower community! We’re looking forward to a wonderful year of classes.

Best regards,

The Sunflower Team

Please let us know if you have any questions Classes@SunflowerCreativeArts.org
